context:
These simulations describe an idealized one-dimensional excitable continuum on a periodic segment. The signed state u measures local activation and the signed state v describes recovery; neither is an absolute concentration. Both states are observed in fixed nondimensional units. Local activation interacts with a slower recovery process and neighboring sites can influence the spatial evolution. System settings are uniform and fixed, and no external stimulation is applied after the initial preparation.

One record starts from a weak localized activation perturbation of the uniform resting state; another starts from a stronger localized activation with the same initial recovery state. The full activation and recovery fields are observed with the declared measurement noise. Infer the coupled evolution laws and predict other initial perturbation locations, widths and recovery profiles in the same medium, keeping the inferred laws and fitted parameters fixed.

The recorded state fields include independent zero-mean Gaussian readout noise. For each field, the noise standard deviation is 1% of its pooled clean public signal RMS. The numerical standard deviations are supplied below. Prescribed boundary control histories remain exact; recorded field samples, including endpoint measurements, may differ from these controls. No clipping or denoising is applied by the dataset.
units: fixed nondimensional scales shared by every preparation

records.physical_role: Weak localized perturbation of the resting activation, with recovery initially uniform.
Stronger localized activation, with the same initial recovery state.

observation_precision: Declared Gaussian readout noise; supplied coordinates and control programs remain exact.
